title: Nac's Modern Fire
description: Fire now can look up-to-date with today's Minecraft!
body:
# A Fresher Flame!

Because fire has had the same texture since nearly it's first introduction,

It just looked off especially next to the campfire! so i fixed that!

Now you can have a fire that might match a bit more nicely with the new textures!

<details>
<summary>List of Changes</summary>

- fire_0 & fire_1 textures
- soul_fire_0 & 1 textures
</details>

## Mod Compat?

Not yet, but you will have to let me know what mods to add fire textures to! 

(i currently only have PMC for comments/feedback) I'll be eager to make consistent textures!

to also keep this pack somewhat updated!


<details>
<summary>Terms of Use</summary>

If you want to use my pack in another resource pack, make sure to credit me,
This also applies if you just modify the same pack, i will ask for credit.

You are free to use my pack personally and include it in videos without issue.

... As long as you don't claim that you made it, in that case i'd get angry.

</details>
